title: Delegations
intro: Who may act on whose behalf for business approvals, and when.
howItWorks: A delegate acts on the delegator's behalf only between the start and the end (times in {{tz}}); the audit records “B on behalf of A”. Loops are refused, and the delegate must hold the approval right too.
readOnly: Your roles do not allow recording delegations. You can see the delegations that concern you.

list.title: Delegations
list.emptyBody: Record a delegation before an absence so your approvals are not delayed.

create.title: Record a delegation
create.description: Enter the start and the end as local times in {{tz}}. At most 366 days.
create.delegatorHint: Access administrators only: record a delegation for another person on their request. Leave empty for your own.
create.scopeHint: Optional: choose a transformation to limit the delegation to it.
create.teamHint: Choose the transformation whose team the delegate belongs to.
create.limitToTransformation: Limit the delegation to this transformation
create.reasonTextHint: Required when you record a delegation on someone's request.

revoke.title: Revoke the delegation
revoke.description: {{delegate}} can no longer act on the delegator's behalf from now on. Past decisions stay recorded.
